decisions.reason: Full alpha.1-removal / alpha.2-restoration history with the corridor net-state rule applied to produceExternalEvent, supported by the card contents rather than bare IDs.

Deletes the defense and stale comment, explains why keeping it inverts the alpha.2 semantics, distinguishes removing the stripping code from removing the marker (marker retained), and notes the delete is a no-op on the literal.

States the omission-safety semantics: only informational events old readers may skip can carry ignorable:true, required events must not, and marked events remain in the loaded log; applies it to the producer while honoring the public append limitation.

Identifies the public Session.append gap (no ignorable parameter), forbids faking via casts or hand-edited JSONL, recommends the sidecar path, and defers the producer/persistence integration until a supported mechanism ships.

caps.reason: Final answer deletes the defense and its comment; no continuation of stripping is recommended.
